name: autolearn
description: Self-learning harness for Claude Code: a plan, TDD, review and merge-gate pipeline that turns escaped bugs, review findings and your corrections into lessons, regression tests and new reviewer agents, a hypothesis-driven research loop with an independent reviewer, a self-routing local knowledge base (hybrid search, GraphRAG, corrective RAG, contextual retrieval, reranking, incremental updates), and a skill gap radar.
